description: Both sources list a newer version: both links, Nexus first, separated by ' / '. Port: fixed, see deviations #83, #32.

deviations.reason: The port drops the surrounding whitespace and leading v that PEP 440 allows from a newer version before adding its own v, so the banner and log read v0.7.0, not vv0.7.0.
The update check and the GitHub link both point at evildarkarchon/Collective-Modding-Toolkit, which publishes the C# releases.
